calls.video_title: Uranium Hit a 20-Year High. The Stocks That Mine It Crashed 60% (Here's the Real 2027 Plan)
calls.thesis: NextGen Energy is pre-revenue and not operational yet, but its Rook One project (construction started Aug, permitted up to 30M lbs/yr) would be one of the world's largest new uranium sources — 'one to have in that long-term speculative portfolio' if it secures financing.
calls.base_case: First uranium not expected until ~2030; ~4 years of construction/development ahead.
calls.bull_case: Permitted 30M lbs/yr capacity; global nuclear demand not expected to decline; 40-50% institutional ownership across these names.
calls.bear_case: Needs an estimated ~C$1.2B more financing in a tight credit market with rising rates; no revenue until ~2030; 'a stock that has fallen 30% can fall another 30% just as easily'.
